WinDV 2.6.0 adds a manual update check and one-click updating.

## Download

- **WinDV-2.6.0-x64-Setup.exe**: the installer for 64-bit Windows (almost every PC).
- **WinDV-2.6.0-x64-portable.zip**: the same app without installing. Unzip anywhere and run `WinDV.exe`.
- **WinDV-2.6.0-x86-Setup.exe** and **WinDV-2.6.0-x86-portable.zip**: the same for 32-bit Windows.

Requires Windows 10 or 11. Your settings from earlier versions (or the original WinDV) carry over.

## New

- **Check for updates on demand**: Settings has a "Check Now" button, in addition to the once-a-day automatic check.
- **One-click update**: on an installed copy, "Update Now" on the update banner downloads the new installer and runs it. Downloads only come from GitHub, including any redirects. The portable zip still updates by hand.

## Fixed

- **Free disk space for new folders**: the free-space display and disk-full guard now work when the capture folder doesn't exist yet.
- **Invalid time format**: a timestamp format such as `%#E` no longer crashes WinDV.
